success_criterion: The endpoint appears once under the correct tenant customer and site with current inventory and a stable identifier
evidence_to_capture: Device record or export showing identifier placement operating system and last check-in
stop_condition: Duplicate misassigned stale or ambiguous endpoint identity

success_criterion: A harmless controlled condition produces the expected alert with device context severity timestamps and an owned route
evidence_to_capture: Alert record plus notification or ticket receipt with timestamps
stop_condition: Missing delayed misrouted or context-free alert

success_criterion: One low-risk approved action reaches only the intended endpoint and records actor target command result and completion state
evidence_to_capture: Job or audit record with output actor target start time and completion time
stop_condition: Wrong target unexpected privilege missing output or ambiguous outcome

success_criterion: A baseline scan controlled patch attempt reboot state and post-action scan reconcile to an understandable final state
evidence_to_capture: Pre-scan selected update job receipt reboot flag post-scan and exception record
stop_condition: Dispatch-only evidence inconsistent state or unresolved unknown outcome

success_criterion: Remote access credentials tokens and the management agent can be removed while required evidence is retained and the endpoint no longer checks in
evidence_to_capture: Revocation and uninstall records final check-in reconciliation and handoff note
stop_condition: Residual access orphaned agent continuing check-in or missing handoff evidence
